name: Keep proofs as regression tests
description: A proof that passed belongs to its use case, stored in its own file, .lastro/proof/<proof-id>-<slug>.json, with its id, slug, name, description, use case, model, subject, check, status and verdict, and the intent and proposal it came from when it came from one; the workspace finds a use case's proofs by their useCase field. Only passed proofs run as regression tests; a pending or failed proof derived from a use case does not. prove(proposal) runs the proposal's pending proofs and the proofs of every use case except the ones the proposal supersedes, so a change that breaks any use case fails as a regression, on a touched use case or not; a superseded proof that still passes is noted, since the behavior may not have changed; failures go back to the implementer through feedback. lastro regress runs every use case's proofs alone, for example in CI. A use case with no proofs yet is reported as unproved rather than failing.
